description: This file defines the KeyboardUIStateHandler class, which manages UI thread operations related to keyboard suggestions and dictionary management in an Android keyboard app.

classes.name: KeyboardUIStateHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes UI thread messages for updating suggestions, restarting word suggestions, and closing dictionaries in the keyboard app.

methods.name: KeyboardUIStateHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a weak reference to the keyboard suggestions object.

methods.name: removeAllSuggestionMessages
methods.description: Removes messages related to updating and restarting suggestions from the message queue.

methods.name: removeAllMessages
methods.description: Removes all suggestion-related messages and dictionary close messages from the message queue.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Overrides the Handler's handleMessage method to process specific messages for updating suggestions, restarting word suggestions, and closing dictionaries.
